title: Radial Transform Extremality for the Siblings of the Coupon Collector
summary: In the siblings version of the coupon collector, a main collector stops when every coupon type has appeared once. Duplicates are passed successively to siblings, and $U_j^N$ denotes the number of empty spaces in the $j$th collector's album at the main completion time. We prove finite-$N$ radial transform strengthenings of the uniform-probability extremality principle.
